## Summary
- Add shared prompt guidance for bounded retries on likely transient `gh`, `git`, `curl`, and network-backed failures.
- Retry hosted OIDC broker exchange responses for HTTP `429`, `500`, `502`, `503`, and `504` while keeping generic `400` responses terminal.
- Document the auth resolver retry contract and add focused shell coverage for transient vs deterministic broker responses.

## Tests
- `npm run build && node --test dist/__tests__/resolve-github-auth-oidc-shell.test.js dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js && bash -n ../.github/actions/resolve-github-auth/exchange-oidc.sh`

Closes #353

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #374 addresses #353 with the narrowed “minimum fix” requested in the issue discussion. It adds shared agent prompt guidance allowing bounded retries for likely transient `gh`, `git`, `curl`, and network-backed failures while warning against retrying deterministic failures. It also hardens the hosted OIDC broker exchange so HTTP `429`, `500`, `502`, `503`, and `504` are retried with bounded backoff, while generic `400` responses remain terminal. Focused shell and docs tests cover the new retry contract.

## Review
The independent reviewers agree this PR is narrow, correct, documented, and covered for the agreed scope. I found no unresolved actionable issues in the current diff, review artifacts, PR discussion, inline comments, or review threads.

Yes. The function is `run_exchange_with_retries` and it uses bounded exponential backoff: delay starts at `1`, sleeps, then doubles with `__delay=$((__delay * 2))`, capped by `3` attempts.

Code: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/57d2c7e6523d37941412a293ee863bb27ac28f07/.github/actions/resolve-github-auth/exchange-oidc.sh#L53-L79

It retries:
- curl/transport failures
- broker HTTP `429`, `500`, `502`, `503`, `504`

It does **not** retry deterministic statuses like generic `400`.

Test coverage confirms `500 -> 429 -> 200` takes 3 attempts, while `400 -> 200` stops after 1 attempt: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/57d2c7e6523d37941412a293ee863bb27ac28f07/.agent/src/__tests__/resolve-github-auth-oidc-shell.test.ts#L146-L165
